## CELL FACTS

Cell 金_偏印 (Metal carrying The Alchemist). Persona The Alchemist (偏印). Definition line: "Unconventional nourishment, the insight that transmutes". Keyword Insight, charge fierce, poles catalyst Vision / friction Distance. Family function: Mind. Cost dimension: nourishment that transmutes; fed on strange food, recipe unshareable. Arena: crucible, moon-side, distillation, the changed substance. Classical portrait: unorthodox absorption; solitary mastery; intake that starves output (枭神夺食). Ruled domains: Learning, Intuition, Solitude. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正印.
Element arena: Metal (edge, blade, ore, forge, whetstone, the clean line). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Metal generating Water same-polarity — precision as the source sustaining depth".
- k2_overview: "Your Metal moves as the Alchemist: a mind that refines. You take raw knowledge and smelt it, testing claims, discarding slag, keeping only what rings true when struck. Your insight is assay-grade and arrives in solitude. Share the refined ingots. The lonely part of the craft is the furnace, not the life."
- k2_functional: "You think by refinement: melt the claim, pour off error, keep the metal."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Cryptic","Hair-splitting","Shut-in"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Learning":"You learn by testing: every teaching struck against evidence before acceptance. Slow intake, permanent retention. Choose dense material worth the smelting. Shallow content wastes your furnace.","Intuition":"Your intuition is metallurgical: a felt sense for what is alloyed with falsehood. When something rings wrong, it is wrong. Trust the ear and verify the details later.","Solitude":"Solitude is your workshop: insight forms only with the door closed. Guard those hours without apology. Just open the shop some evenings. Refined gold unshared stays ore."}

- Sibling cell 金_正印 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Discreet","Preserving","Old soul"],"friction":["Detached","Formal","Locked-away"]}
- Sibling cell 金_正印 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "What enters your keeping stays kept. The friend’s diagnosis, the colleague’s exit plans, the family matter: all held in a vault whose combination has never leaked once. In an age of broadcast, your silence is heirloom-grade, and people inventory it correctly as treasure."

Core element Water, energy element Metal. Law: Metal feeds Water (金生水: dew beads on the cold blade). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Metal is this core's Mind. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Water core that shows Metal on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Metal as the Mind is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 水_金's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You test everything before you let it in. A fact only becomes yours once tried against something real, and that puts testing ahead of simply learning. Keep the slow filter, and what you know stays yours for good.

value_b.text: Every claim gets tested before you keep it. You need to know a thing for yourself, and that is why you hold it up to something real instead of taking anyone's word. Allow the slow start, and you get a knowing that never needs checking.

value.text: Testing everything costs you time. Slow and sure matters more to you than quick and wrong, so most of your learning starts late. Let one good teacher skip the test, because every hour spent proving the known is an hour not spent learning the new.

value.text: Whenever someone hands you a fact, you test it in front of them. Trying it yourself matters more than being agreeable, and whoever offered it gets a question instead of thanks. If you test it later in private, you keep both fact and goodwill.

value.text: You are rarely fooled. Being wrong about a person costs you more than being slow to trust one, so you weigh the uneasy feeling ahead of the pleasant proof. Keep that ear, and let a kind person prove it wrong from time to time.

value_b.text: Fooling you takes work. You check a story against the feeling before it is finished, and you trust the feeling more than the smile beside it. Let a good smile in anyway, since catching a lie is worth less than a friend.

value.text: Rarely fooled, you are slow to be glad. You check a kind offer for the catch before letting it near, and would rather miss a good thing than be fooled. Take one offer at its word, and the good your doubt sends away gets in.

value.text: Your best thinking happens alone. You need quiet for a half-formed idea more than an audience, so you shut the door until it is whole. If you bring one person in at the halfway point, you keep the quiet without the loneliness.

value_b.text: You think alone, then arrive with the answer finished. You would rather be late than be seen mid-thought, and the working stays yours alone until it holds. If you say the half-made version to one person, you get the finished one sooner.

value.text: Thinking alone keeps the idea clean. You would rather carry a hard question alone than let anyone see it unsolved, and help only reaches a problem someone has heard about. If you tell one person early, you get the help you have been doing without.
